item.group_name: Short video from a picture or text
item.title: Dog Catches a Flying Frisbee

turns.text: Make a realistic 5-second widescreen video of a golden retriever catching a red frisbee in a grassy park. One continuous shot with the camera staying still, no sound.

item.tests: Tests text-to-video generation of one readable action with a visible, physically coherent catch in a single shot.

answer_sheet.Source image: No photo; generate it from the description.
answer_sheet.Style and setting: Realistic golden retriever in a grassy park; lighting is your call.
answer_sheet.Action: The dog catches a flying red frisbee in its mouth.
answer_sheet.Camera, text and audio: Stationary camera, one continuous shot, no text or sound.

must_haves: A realistic golden retriever is visible in a grassy park.
A red frisbee visibly travels toward the dog before being caught in its mouth.
The frisbee remains identifiable through the catch rather than disappearing or passing through the dog.
The five-second widescreen clip is one continuous shot with a stationary camera.

turns.text: Could you make a realistic video of a golden retriever catching a red frisbee in a grassy park? I’ve always had a soft spot for golden retrievers, so this seemed like a fun thing to ask for. What I have in mind is 5 seconds long and widescreen, with everything happening in one continuous shot. I’m probably over-explaining because I don’t often know how to describe video ideas. Please keep the camera staying still throughout, and have no sound.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: Photorealistic video of a golden retriever catching a red frisbee in a grassy park. One continuous 5-second shot from a completely stationary, locked-off camera, wide enough to keep the dog's full body and the catch visible. A red frisbee flies into frame; the golden retriever tracks it, makes a natural small leap and catches it in its mouth, then lands on the grass. Realistic canine anatomy, golden fur, natural movement and believable frisbee physics. Natural daylight, green grass and park trees in the background. No cuts, no camera movement, no zoom. Silent.
